description: Repairs r-expr-1/b-fixed-point-fidelity: M held Null, not a Decimal. Asks whether the stored Decimal M survives identity, unary minus, +0, *1, CDbl, CCur, division and comparison, next to the Currency C forms; M is read back first. CDec is not used. Each expression is its own snapshot. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
